overview: This Senate resolution mourns the death of Howard L. Hawks, a Nebraska businessman and philanthropist, and honors his life. It recounts that he co-founded Tenaska Energy in Omaha in 1987 and grew it into one of the largest private companies in the country, served as a University of Nebraska regent for 18 years and a Creighton University board member for 12 years, and supported many university buildings, academic programs, medical fellowships, scholarships, and efforts on homelessness and mental health. The resolution asks the Secretary of the Senate to send a copy to his family. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on February 25, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution is a fitting tribute to a civic leader whose business and giving left a lasting mark on Nebraska and its universities.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
